data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German word elmar, which means 'elf power' or 'little warrior'. in_hebrew.name: אלמו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלמו נגזר מהמילה העברית אלוהים והוא אדוני, שם שמשמעותו אלוהים הוא אדוני ונותן כוח ושליטה לאדם הנושא שם זה. השם אלמו מופיע בתנך כחלק מהמנון התודה והשבח לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Έλμο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Έλμο προέρχεται από την ελληνική μετάφραση της λέξης אלוהים, που σημαίνει Θεός. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η λέξη Θεός χρησιμοποιείται για να δηλώσει τον Παντοδύναμο. Το Έλμο συνδέεται με την πίστη και την αφοσίωση στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Elmo
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elmo derivatur ex voce Latina Deus, quae significat Deum. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Dei erat symbolum potestatis et dominationis. Elmo significat Deum esse Dominum et protectorem.

in_english.name: Elmo
in_english.long_meaning: The name Elmo originates from Hebrew and Greek roots, signifying 'God is my lord.' It embodies a profound spiritual connection and submission to divine will. Historically, Elmo has been used in Christian traditions to denote a strong faith and reliance on God.

celebrity_usage: Elmo, the beloved Sesame Street character

Elmo has entertained and educated children around the world since his introduction in 1972, and has become a beloved and iconic symbol of childhood innocence and playful creativity.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Elmo can be found in its original Old High German roots – 'elf power' or 'little warrior.' This name invokes images of strength, resilience, and the power of the spirit to overcome challenges. It is a reminder that even in the face of adversity, each of us has the inner power to rise above and conquer, like a tiny warrior with great strength. In a Christian context, this name can also be seen as a reminder of the presence of God's protective power in our lives, and the importance of trusting in His strength during difficult times.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Elmo, meaning "God to me" in Hebrew, symbolizes the deep faith and devotion an individual has towards God. This name is a constant reminder of one's reliance and trust in the divine power and guidance of the Almighty.
